customManagers.description: Bump the phx-adr pins in CI, the root AGENTS.md and the template together (ADR 018).
Track the workflows' annotated env pins, such as the Renovate validator's (ADR 026), here and in the template.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh uv.lock weekly, merging once CI passes, so transitive dependencies reach the harness without a direct pin, as the template's projects do (ADR 013).

packageRules.description: Never bump Python: CI's versions follow copier.yml's python_policy, which the rotate-python-versions skill moves (ADR 015).

Never bump the GitHub provider's major in the template: the todofixthis Terraform module owns that constraint, so a new major arrives with a module release, raised alongside the module pin (ADR 025; ADR 001 in todofixthis/terraform-github-repository).
Bump the Renovate validator pin's minor and patch releases monthly, merging once gate passes, since Renovate releases several times a day; a major waits for review (ADR 026).
